subject: stick or pad?
author: PsychedelicBabe
body: 😛i tried using the stick today again today and i do like it but i have to say i prefer my D-Pad..... you said ''do what you have to do to win'' and it made me realize i mean im not a bad racer im quite consistent at times and i very seldomly crash....i can boost jump i can boost drift damn i can even harrier.....but when i use the stick i cant?.....so im sticking with my D-Pad sorry but i am its suited me well over the last 3 years so why change now?.... i have tried so it makes me feel better knowing that ive tried it and i dont like it......but somebody mentioned in another forum about other racing games and i manage fine on them with the stick.....so yeah i like my STICK....😉...just not on burnout.....😇

subject: Jose The Jalpeno on a Stick.
author: SUFFUR
body:
The ladies are supposed to like da stick? But then I like the Stick and I be a man.😳

It's like First Person View and 3rd Person View.

Do what needs to be done to win, without cheating of course.

I am a Stick'man, multiview, boost jumping racer.

Patience is something I taught myself, so I never know when it's going to run out?
